title: Children have fundamental right to play; residents association cannot prohibit it: Karnataka High Court
description: Children have a fundamental right to play games and apartment owners' association cannot restrict the same arbitrarily, the Karnataka High Court recently held [Sangeetha Agarwal v Esteem Gardenia Apartment Owners Association].Justice Hanchate Sanjeevkumar made the observation while quashing a residents association's decision to prohibit children from using the playground in the apartment.
